name: P7: empty () splits onto two lines when the line overflows
note: LOGS-5799 problem 7 (open): when the declaration exceeds the 100-col limit, the empty () is the only break point — '(' stays at the end of the line and ');' dangles on its own. Wanted: break after '=' and keep () together. The length matters: a shorter line fits and never reproduces it. Anonymised reconstruction. https://st.yandex-team.ru/LOGS-5799
